The '''Treaty at Bresnan''' was signed on [[Bresnan]] in one of the years preceding [[3642 BBY]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ki Sazen]] played an important role in the signing of the treaty and considered it one of her personal accomplishments.<ref name="TOR" />
